name: Health Knowhow - Medical Source Review - REVIEW ENGINE DRY RUN

nodes.name: Manual Trigger Only
nodes.notes: Manual execution only. No webhook, no schedule, no production workflow connection. This workflow performs read-only draft GET and one safe source fetch preview API POST only.

nodes.name: Controlled Dry-Run Input
nodes.notes: Controlled first review-engine dry-run input for revision 13. To review another revision, explicitly edit this node. Do not store tokens or secrets here.

nodes.name: Input Valid Check
nodes.notes: False branch terminates immediately. Draft GET is only connected from the true branch.

nodes.name: Extract Claim Candidates
nodes.notes: Extracts candidate claims from actual title, summary, bodyMarkdown, and structuredContent. It must not use hardcoded claim results.

nodes.name: Build Safe Source Fetch Request
nodes.notes: Builds safe source preview API request from draft.sources sourceId values only. URL, hostname, method, claim text, source text, and tokens are never placed in the request body.

nodes.name: Fetch Sources via Safe Preview API

httpHeaderAuth.name: Health Knowhow Source Fetch Preview Header Auth

nodes.notes: Calls the server-side safe source fetch preview API exactly once. Configure separate Header Auth credential in n8n credential storage only: header name Authorization, header value from INTERNAL_SOURCE_FETCH_PREVIEW_TOKEN, domain health-knowhow.vercel.app. Token value must never be stored in workflow JSON.

nodes.name: Safe Source Preview Contract Verify
nodes.notes: Fails closed if safe preview API response is not read-only, not dry-run, exposes full source text fields, mismatches sourceIds, or reports any write side effect.
